title: Analog Layout Engineer
summary: Draws the physical layout of analog and mixed-signal circuits such as regulators, PLLs and data converters, by hand in Cadence Virtuoso. Works next to circuit designers and makes sure layouts match well, avoid noise and pass DRC, LVS and reliability checks before tape-out.
dailyDuties: Lay out analog blocks such as LDOs, bandgaps and PLLs in Virtuoso
Place matched devices with common centroid and interdigitation
Add guard rings and follow ESD and latch-up rules
Clean DRC and LVS errors with Calibre or PVS
Run parasitic extraction and fix issues it shows
Review floorplans and parasitics with circuit designers

skills.expectation: Lay out analog and mixed-signal blocks such as LDOs, bandgaps, PLLs and ADCs in Virtuoso
Use common centroid, interdigitation, dummies, guard rings and shielding for matching and noise
Clean DRC, LVS and ERC on custom layout with Calibre or PVS
Run parasitic extraction and fix layout issues the post-layout results show
Follow ESD and latch-up rules in device placement and routing
Size wires and vias for electromigration and IR drop
Discuss floorplans and parasitic trade-offs with circuit designers
Lay out in FinFET nodes with their patterning and layout-dependent effects
Automate layout tasks with SKILL, Perl or Tcl scripts
Integrate analog blocks into the chip floorplan with the PD team
Work in a Linux EDA environment
